entries.description: Guide to 25 fitness calculators on RepMaths for strength training, 5/3/1 programming, RPE and RIR, barbell plate loading, nutrition, and body composition. Covers 1RM estimation (Epley, Brzycki, Lander, Lombardi), TDEE and BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict), body fat (US Navy method), BMI, lean body mass, FFMI, ideal weight, protein intake, water intake, and calories burned.
representativeQueries: 1RM calculator for squat, bench press, or deadlift
barbell plate calculator for a target weight
body composition calculator for body fat, BMI, or FFMI
